缺失 39 个 (19.5%)

=== 机制判据 ===

  MNAR: 缺失与缺失值本身有关 -> 删除必然有偏, 且无法用数据自证

code:
# 缺失机制与填充策略对比: 量化"填充的代价"
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 200
truth = rng.normal(50, 10, n)          # 真实值(不可观测)
df = pd.DataFrame({"v": truth, "group": rng.choice(["A", "B"], n)})

# MCAR: 随机挖掉 20%
mask = rng.choice([True, False], n, p=[0.2, 0.8])
df["v_missing"] = df["v"].where(~mask)

print("真实数据     : 均值=%.3f 方差=%.3f" % (df["v"].mean(), df["v"].var(ddof=1)))
print("缺失 %d 个 (%.1f%%)" % (int(mask.sum()), mask.mean() * 100))
print("")

print("=== 策略对比(均在含缺失的数据上操作) ===")
s = df["v_missing"]

def report(label, filled):
    print("  %-16s 均值=%.3f 方差=%.3f 标准差=%.3f" % (label, filled.mean(), filled.var(ddof=1), filled.std(ddof=1)))

report("删除缺失(参照)", s.dropna())
report("均值填充", s.fillna(s.mean()))
report("中位数填充", s.fillna(s.median()))
report("分组均值填充", df.assign(v=df["v_missing"]).groupby("group")["v"].transform(lambda x: x.fillna(x.mean())))
report("前向填充", s.ffill())

print("")
print("=== 关键结论: 均值填充压缩方差 ===")
n_obs = int(s.notna().sum())
var_obs = s.dropna().var(ddof=1)
var_fill = s.fillna(s.mean()).var(ddof=1)
# 均值填充后: 观测点偏离总均值(仍是观测均值, 离差和=0), 缺失点贡献 0
#   SS = (n_obs-1)*var_obs  ->  var(ddof=1) = SS/(n-1) = (n_obs-1)/(n-1) * var_obs
ratio_naive = n_obs / n
ratio_exact = (n_obs - 1) / (n - 1)
print("  观测占比 n_obs/n = %d/%d = %.4f (粗略直觉)" % (n_obs, n, ratio_naive))
print("  精确收缩因子 (n_obs-1)/(n-1) = %d/%d = %.4f" % (n_obs - 1, n - 1, ratio_exact))
pred = ratio_exact * var_obs
print("  理论预测方差 = %.4f * %.4f = %.4f" % (ratio_exact, var_obs, pred))
print("  实测填充后方差 = %.4f" % var_fill)
rel = abs(var_fill - pred) / pred
print("  相对误差 = %.3e -> 一致(ddof=1 口径) : %s" % (rel, str(rel < 1e-9)))
print("  -> 均值填充把方差压缩为原来的 %.2f%%, 相关性与回归斜率会随之被衰减" % (ratio_exact * 100))

print("")
print("=== 相关性衰减实证 ===")
x = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
df["x"] = x
df["y"] = 3 * x + rng.normal(0, 1, n)
df["y_missing"] = pd.Series(df["y"]).where(~pd.Series(mask))
r_true = float(df["x"].corr(df["y"]))
r_drop = float(df["x"].corr(df["y_missing"]))
r_fill = float(df["x"].corr(df["y_missing"].fillna(df["y_missing"].mean())))
print("  真实相关系数       : %.4f" % r_true)
print("  删除缺失后         : %.4f" % r_drop)
print("  均值填充后         : %.4f" % r_fill)
print("  -> 均值填充把相关系数从 %.4f 衰减到 %.4f, 衰减幅度 %.1f%%"
      % (r_drop, r_fill, abs(r_drop - r_fill) / abs(r_drop) * 100))

print("")
print("=== 机制判据 ===")
print("  MCAR: 缺失与任何变量无关 -> 删除只损失样本量, 不引入偏差")
print("  MAR : 缺失与已观测变量有关 -> 可用其他变量分组填充")
print("  MNAR: 缺失与缺失值本身有关 -> 删除必然有偏, 且无法用数据自证")
print("  工程兜底: 保留缺失并加一列 *_is_missing, 让模型自己判断这个信号")
